capabilities: install and enable community plugins from a JSON list with optional version pins
apply plugin settings from a JSON file with merge or replace
export and import theme, CSS snippets, hotkeys, core plugins, bookmarks and Obsidian settings
preview imports and undo the last changes
check for plugin updates while keeping settings and pins
extras: README carries security warnings: the plugin can download other plugins with full vault access, auto-install is off by default, and users must review JSON lists before enabling it. Secrets are masked in exports. Detailed troubleshooting, network-use disclosure (no telemetry), and undo backups (last 10) are documented.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to reproduce a vault's plugin set, plugin settings and appearance on another device or to share that setup as a package.
summary: Installs, enables and configures community plugins from JSON files in the vault, and syncs theme, snippets, hotkeys and settings across devices.
